                j=i
                while j+3 <= len(s):

                        aa=s[i:j+3]

                            orfs.append((frame if not is_rev else frame+3, start, end, len(prot), prot))

def scan_strand(s, off, is_rev):
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(s)-2):
        if s[i:i+3]=='ATG':
            j=i; aa=[]
            while j+3<=len(s):
                a=code[s[j:j+3]]
                if a=='*': break
                aa.append(a); j+=3
            if len(aa)>=30:
                # j..j+2 is the stop codon in s-coordinates; coding span is i..j+2
                if is_rev:
                    # R[i] -> orig L-i (rightmost); R[j+2] -> orig L-(j+2) (leftmost)
                    start = L-(j+2); end = L-i
                else:
                    start = off+i+1; end = off+j+3
                out.append((start,end,len(''.join(aa)),''.join(aa)))
    return out

def scan(s, is_rev):
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(s)-2):
        if s[i:i+3]=='ATG':
            j=i; aa=[]
            while j+3<=len(s):
                a=code[s[j:j+3]]
                if a=='*': break
                aa.append(a); j+=3
            ran_to_end = (j+3 > len(s))
            if len(aa)>=30:
                if is_rev:
                    start=L-(j+2) if not ran_to_end else L-(j-1)   # handle edge below properly
                    start = L-(j+2) if not ran_to_end else L-(len(s)-1)
                    # when ORF runs to the very end of s (i.e., position 0 of orig), start = 1
                    if ran_to_end: start = 1
                    end   = L-i
                else:
                    start=i+1; end=j+3
                out.append((start,end,len(''.join(aa)),''.join(aa), ran_to_end))
    return out
